invariants.rule: GlassHelix owns scientific models, evidence and inference meaning; Torch supplies ordinary ML. CelleraTorch owns framework integration; native Cellerator owns reusable biological math, differentiation, parameter/value contracts, geometry, planning and compiler/runtime. No parallel GH ML runtime or CT kernel home.

A biology-purpose learning operation needs an explicit model assumption, semantic contract, exact reference and identified computational advantage to test. Biological labels or a generic ML kernel alone do not establish this. Model restrictions are hypotheses, not truths or hardware requirements.

Preserve actual measurement relationships and allowed information. Population snapshots and sibling cells are not individual trajectories; nominal common forcing is not identical intracellular input. No held-out ATAC, future targets or target-derived preprocessing in unauthorized inference.

Keep biological/structure identity independent of physical layout and encoding. Preserve ordered and repeated arguments, actual saved-primal generations, lawful contribution assembly and canonical parameter ownership. Never hide mutation inside the new composable backward.

Preserve successful NF1A, compiler, relation, geometry and CelleraTorch work and separate Todo authorities. No retirement, runtime replacement, old-plan reapply, unrelated cleanup, preprint edits or Ampere-epic activation is authorized.

Use coarse outcomes and evidence-selected alternatives. Reuse ordinary Torch and existing Cellerator compositions before new kernels. Easy work may proceed immediately. A costly design needs an explicit rationale, not a universal framework or mandatory survey.

Separate engineering correctness, scientific adequacy, numerical policy and performance. Searched candidates are not an exhaustive compatible set; no fabricated biology, derivative support, compiler coverage or speedup.

tasks.title: Choose and make executable one biology-purpose learning formulation
tasks.objective: Turn the supplied design study into one small scientific model/reference and an explicit GH/CT/CE demand. This is deliberation at the hard boundary, not a new universal ML architecture.

required: State the question, allowed observations, model level, latent/state/forcing roles, principal non-identifiabilities and the chosen primary experiment arm. A conditional choice may remain provisional until the data coverage audit.

Use BIOLOGICAL_ML.md to select/refine one justified learning construction or reject it in favor of a better-supported one. Record the biology assumption, exact expression, trainable unknowns, derivative/contribution meaning, exploitable structure and a counterexample/control. No new kernel is required merely to finish design.

Provide a small executable Torch mathematical reference or reuse an existing equivalent. Compare the same model under straightforward and structure-preserving computation; do not confuse changing the model with accelerating it.

Publish one concise consumer demand and decision record separating ordinary Torch, CT exposure/lifecycle, CE reusable math and optional compiler work. Ordinary wiring and data work need not await a universal design review.

delegated_choices: The worked shared-support/activity candidate is preferred for low initial cost, not compulsory. A measured scientific reason may select n-ary or another formulation.

tasks.title: Express scientific inference over Torch and CelleraTorch
tasks.objective: Implement the smallest reusable GH evidence/hypothesis/conditioning/result layer and one fitted scientific model using ordinary Torch plus the qualified CT/CE path.

required: Fit genuinely unknown shared law quantities and local hidden/initial quantities. Reuse Torch modules, parameter registration, autograd, optimizers and state dictionaries; GH adds scientific roles, evidence permissions, hypotheses, conditioning and interpretation, not a parallel ML engine.

Separate global fitting, retrospective reconstruction and prospective held-out conditioning. Freeze global quantities for conditioning, prohibit target access and preserve unresolved forcing/state and whole alternative explanations.

Connect at least one fitted component to the existing NF1A typed system/evolution/interrogation boundary, comparing the same frozen values and declared observable or selected response. Do not translate arbitrary Torch models into a new GH IR or force every model to be Markovian.

Use the CE-ML2-TRAIN producer path as an actual composed trainable operation; a pure-Torch prototype can proceed while it is developed but is not the final integrated-substrate acceptance. Capability flags, not mere class names, control supported responses.

Save underlying model state through its actual owner plus a GH scientific manifest. Reload in a fresh process with stable logical identity and reproduce predictions; do not serialize pointers, streams or stale prepared caches.
